# Productize Yourself with AI

> Productize Yourself with AI (also spelt Productise Yourself) is a live 2027 programme by Ross Power, founder of AI Powered. It is built for two goals: go from 0 to your first $5,000 month, or from $5,000 to your first $10,000 month, in USD or GBP. Two live calls a week. The programme runs on Pistachio, the software Ross is building. Apply before 31 December 2026 for 50% off when it goes live, plus early-bird perks.

If you are already past $10k a month, it is still highly valuable. This is the formula Ross used to hit $20k months, repeatedly, in his first year in business.

Programmes trusted by > 150 people so far.

## What "productize yourself" means

"Productize yourself" is Naval Ravikant's two-word summary of how to build wealth: find what you are uniquely good at and apply as much leverage as possible. Productize has specific knowledge and leverage. Yourself has uniqueness and accountability. Productize Yourself with AI is the programme that turns that idea into six phases you work through with Claude. Naval is not affiliated with the programme.

## How it was built

Ross Power spent ten years as a product manager in startups and at some of the biggest companies in the world. He then ran two Productize Yourself programmes, iterated the method in the room, and ran five Claude programmes, with a sixth underway. That is 18 months and more than 1,500 hours of teaching both. This programme is the merger of those two paths.

The method also draws on Dan Koe, Alex Hormozi, Daniel Priestley and Tom Noske. None of them are affiliated with the programme.

## The six phases

1. Person: identity and IP (identity excavation, your IP map, ideal client profile, future self design)
2. Proof: market validation (competitor matrix, market intelligence brief)
3. Promise: your signature offer
4. Profile: content and visibility
5. Pipeline: client acquisition
6. Partner: scale and partnerships

## How it works

- Live sessions with Ross Power, each one recorded and saved in your workspace
- A workspace on Pistachio (heypistachio.ai), the learning platform Ross co-founded
- A library of 500+ prompts tested in real sessions, plus the skills Ross uses in his own business
- You need your own Claude subscription with the desktop app, plus Google Drive for desktop or OneDrive

## Who it is for

Coaches, consultants and experts who earn under $10k a month from what they know and want a named, repeatable offer and a steady flow of clients. People already past $10k a month are pointed to Upgrade, a community for established founders.

## About Ross Power

Ross Power is the founder of AI Powered, an AI education and events company. More than 800 people have been through AI Powered events, programmes and masterclasses.
